name: PASCAL Context: Dense Full-Scene Semantic Segmentation Dataset
description: PASCAL Context extends the PASCAL VOC 2010 detection challenge by providing pixel-wise annotations for the entire scene (both stuff and thing categories) across 10,103 images, encompassing over 400 detailed categories.

publisher.name: Stanford University & University of California Los Angeles

license.name: Custom Academic Research / Flickr Terms
license.notes: Annotations provided freely for research by the authors; underlying images are governed by PASCAL VOC 2010 terms and Flickr user licenses.

source_references.title: The Role of Context for Object Detection and Semantic Segmentation in the Wild

verification.notes: Verified against CVPR 2014 paper (DOI: 10.1109/CVPR.2014.119) and dataset distribution. Covers 10,103 images from PASCAL VOC 2010 (train: 4,998, val: 5,105) with 59 most frequent evaluation classes plus background.

size.notes: MAT annotation files and VOC JPEG images.

citation.paper_title: The Role of Context for Object Detection and Semantic Segmentation in the Wild
